facts.fact: 每位 New Ground 居民都要填一张表，写明重病与死亡时的心愿，并留下近亲的联系方式。
facts.anchor: Everyone at New Ground fills in a form stating their wishes around serious illness and death

facts.fact: 九年里已有两位居民去世：Jayne 在护理院走完最后的日子，Shirley 则从医院回到自己的公寓离世。
facts.anchor: two women have died in the last nine years

facts.fact: Shirley 临终前由一位儿子搬进来陪最后几周，另配一名夜班护士，社区的人因此可以每天探视。
facts.anchor: one of her sons would move in for her final weeks, along with a night nurse

facts.fact: 最近一次会议的议程上列了“葬礼”，一部分人想谈，另一部分人谈不下去。
facts.anchor: which some of the group had wanted to include, while others did not feel comfortable discussing it

facts.fact: 一位 death doula（临终陪伴者）来 New Ground 做讲座，讲清楚的指示对留下来的人有什么用。
facts.anchor: a woman who is present at the end of life as an emotional and spiritual support

facts.fact: Sue T 填好预立医疗决定表，却把它封在一只写明“仅在失能或死亡时开启”的信封里。
facts.anchor: keeps it in a sealed envelope marked

facts.fact: Janet 决定把自己的追思会办在公共活动室，因为她在这里最快乐，也会在这里被记住。
facts.anchor: Janet has decided she wants her wake in the common room

facts.fact: Janet 提醒大家，每个人比刚搬进来时都老了九岁。
facts.anchor: everyone is nine years older than when they first moved in
